login.passwordInvalid: Password must contain 8+ characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character

successMessage.title: Thank you for registering!
successMessage.message1: To complete the process of activating your account, please check your email and follow the link in the email we sent. After that, you will be able to use all the features of our site.
successMessage.message2: If you did not receive the email, please check your 'Spam' folder. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to Contact us. Thank you!

errorMessage.title: Oops! Something went wrong
errorMessage.message1: A registration error occurred. Please try again later
errorMessage.message2: If you are unable to register on your second attempt, please contact us using the link below
errorMessage.emailExistsLine1: The email you are using is already registered
errorMessage.emailExistsLine2: Log in using the link below

success.text1: ✅ Your email has been verified! You've been automatically logged in

successCoach.title: Coach Registration
successCoach.message1: Your registration request has been sent to the administrator. You will receive an email once it’s approved.
successCoach.message2: If you registered as a coach by mistake, your account will be removed by the administrator after a short time, and you’ll be able to sign up as a regular user.

userNotFound.title: User Not Found
userNotFound.message1: No account is registered with this email address.
userNotFound.message2: Please check the email or sign up for a new account.

userHasNoPassword.title: Login Error
userHasNoPassword.message1: This account was created using Google Sign-In.

wrongPassword.title: Incorrect Password
wrongPassword.message1: The password you entered is incorrect.

notVerify.title: Email Not Verified
notVerify.message1: A verification link has been sent to your email.
notVerify.message2: If you're having trouble, please contact us.

logout.title: Logout?
logout.message1: Are you sure you want to log out?
logout.message2: All unsaved data will be lost!

protectedRoutInfo.title: Access Denied
protectedRoutInfo.message1: You must be a registered and verified user
protectedRoutInfo.message2: Register and verify your email to access your personal calendar.
